ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 macro-ratio of high-intensity white pixels (lobes) to low-intensity black pixels (central peduncle and periphery).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the lateral lobes, separated by a central low-intensity black vertical zone. Black mottling and stippling are visible along the boundary between the white and black regions, particularly at the lower edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 90-degree V-shaped depression at the center; deep focal depth relative to the overall fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary; prominent jagged peaks on the inner-right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral sigmoid curve with an upward concave sweep leading to acuminate distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible clusters of circular, textured, high-intensity white protrusions (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, low-intensity vertical linear streaks are visible on the left lobe's white surface; several short, dark horizontal disruptions near the trailing edge of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at both distal tips; irregular black pigmentation patches along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Punctate black spots scattered within the high-intensity white region of the right lobe.
